why: Both share the same sofa, coffee table, lamp, cushions and pot, so the choice rests on the bookcase and rug. A's 160x30x90 cm black metal and pale wood bookcase suits the wall, and its blue and rust rug brings earthy tones, though the blue is not a pure earth tone. B's bookcase is only 43 cm high and 21 cm deep, so it is too low and small to work as the library the client asked for. B's grey rug is also less earthy and less warm.
